briefing_summary_en: This briefing covers eight sections. AI and LLM research focuses on GUI-agent history compression, verifiable evidence-grounded reasoning, unified evaluation, and persistent human control; Replit says OpenAI has replaced Anthropic as its default model provider. Science highlights the Roman Space Telescope alignment exceeding expectations and a newly created “fractional Fermi sea” quantum state. Internationally, Ukraine launched over 1,000 drones at Russia and set oil facilities ablaze; Trump defended sanctions relief for Russia; Gaza faces acute food shortages. China coverage includes senior diplomats’ trips, satellite-internet polar tests, and Long March archives. Finance notes an MSCI warning triggering an Indonesian stocks-bonds-rupiah selloff and Asian chip losses tied to DeepSeek’s model and AI funding worries. Developer, startup and opinion sections cover tool releases, product launches and Hacker News debates.

sections.briefing_title: AI 与大模型：GUI智能体、评估治理与模型平台变动
sections.briefing_summary: 本期入选文章包括三项前沿模型研究：ECHOES用递归历史压缩与特权在线策略蒸馏减少GUI智能体历史截图令牌，Harness-Delta归因拆解Harness演化带来的性能增益，PRIME面向LLM智能体提出可验证证据推理；产品侧，Replit CEO表示OpenAI已取代Anthropic成为默认模型提供商；研究与治理侧，HeRE构建希伯来语关系抽取基准，AuditKIT与RealCLI分别提出统一评估框架和CLI人机协作基准，结构化授权注入通过类型化MCP覆盖维持人类控制，功能性福利则把AI福利纳入安全讨论。
sections.briefing_title_en: AI and Large Models: GUI Agents, Evaluation, Governance, and a Platform Shift
sections.briefing_summary_en: The selected articles include three frontier-model studies: ECHOES uses recursive history compression and privileged on-policy distillation to cut historical screenshot tokens for GUI agents, Harness-Delta attribution dissects performance gains from harness evolution, and PRIME proposes verifiable evidence-grounded reasoning for LLM agents. On the product side, Replit’s CEO said OpenAI has replaced Anthropic as the default model provider. In research and governance, HeRE builds a Hebrew relation-extraction benchmark, AuditKIT and RealCLI propose unified evaluation and CLI human-agent collaboration benchmarks, structured authority injection uses typed MCP overrides for persistent human control, and functional welfare brings AI welfare into safety discussion.

sections.briefing_summary_en: This Science and Technology briefing covers space observation and home robots as well as fundamental physics, brain aging and depression research. After a tiny mirror adjustment, NASA's Roman Space Telescope delivered image quality nearly 30% better than expected; Webb found three recurring weather states on a planet 20 light-years away; and astronomers reported evidence of a second supermassive black hole at Mrk 501, with the pair potentially colliding within about 100 years. In research, physicists who discovered altermagnetism won a major physics prize; a “fractional Fermi sea” was created in ultracold atoms; restoring a youth-linked protein improved brain immune-cell function in older mice; and a deep brain stimulation study identified three brain pathways linked to lasting depression relief.
